stories.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cost-efficient model designed for reliable agentic workflows and everyday tasks. This model brings cutting-edge intelligence to a wider audience and is available across various Google AI platforms.

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
stories.explanation: Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia is expected to significantly impact AI startup funding, with VCs and founders anticipating smaller checks and lower valuations. Nvidia was a major investor in AI startups, and his absence creates uncertainty in the funding landscape.

stories.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
stories.explanation: New research indicates that China's most powerful AI models were trained on Nvidia chips banned for export to China, following Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia. This highlights a significant challenge to US export controls aimed at limiting China's AI capabilities.

stories.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a secure payment method for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots, allowing agents to complete purchases with user approval without accessing card details. This aims to build trusted agentic payments and enable businesses to accept payments from ChatGPT Wallet.

stories.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
stories.explanation: ggml-org released llama.cpp v1.0.0, providing a stable API for running multi-modal LLMs across various hardware through quantization and optimized backends. This release emphasizes API stability for developers building cross-platform and private AI products.

stories.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
stories.explanation: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its Dots AI agents to make purchases for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US. This development enables AI agents to perform transactional tasks, with user approval required for each purchase.

stories.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.explanation: AI agent startup LangChain raised $300 million at a $3 billion valuation, focusing on its LangSmith agent management tool. This funding highlights significant investment in companies providing platform-agnostic solutions for managing AI agents.

stories.title: No Pilots. Few Air Traffic Controllers. What Could Go Wrong?
stories.explanation: The US transportation secretary introduced 'SMART,' an AI-infused air traffic control system, which was later questioned during a national groundstop. This indicates the increasing, though sometimes uncertain, integration of AI in critical infrastructure like aviation.

stories.title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
stories.explanation: Anthropic launched Claude's Duet agent, a consumer-grade AI agent focused on work-oriented tasks. This introduces a new AI assistant aimed at helping users with productivity.

stories.title: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood
stories.explanation: Mansa, a media company, is using AI to create 'microdramas' to promote Black stories in Hollywood, such as the entirely AI-generated series 'They Left Us to Die.' This initiative explores AI's role in content creation, though it has drawn criticism for not using human actors.
